text:
Ana M.: Quick idea — can we try a 'timerboard' for postmortem actions? Something that visually tracks ownership, SLAs, and recurrence tags. I'd like to propose a template and a small rotation schedule for IC.

Dmitri K.: +1. current follow-ups slip because owners forget the 30/60/90 check-ins. Timerboard + auto reminders sounds good.

Sara P.: Can we keep it lightweight? Maybe a single spreadsheet first, with columns: Action, Owner, Priority, Due, SLA (hours), Status, RecurrenceTag. Then sync to calendar for IC rotation.

Will - oncall: I can prototype a sheet. Also want to capture recurring incident pattern tags so we can run quarterly retros.

Ana M.: here's a basic template (feel free to copy):

```
Action | Owner | Priority | Due | SLA_hours | Status | Recurrence
Fix race in kv-cache | Dmitri K. | P0 | 2026-04-02 | 72 | In progress | kv-cache
Add canary for model-variant fallback | Sara P. | P1 | 2026-04-15 | 336 | Todo | routing
Run 30/60/90 check | Will - oncall | P2 | 2026-05-02 | 720 | Todo | followup
```

Also propose these rules:
- Owners must ack within 48h
- If SLA missed, oncall escalates and adds an action to current incident
- Tag actions with 'recurrence:quarterly' if related to systemic patterns

Dmitri K.: Love the SLA_hours column. For automation, incident-bot can post weekly digest of actions with SLA<168h.

incident-bot: [automated] Will post action digest every Monday 09:00 UTC for channels: #eng-oncall, #postmortem-actions

Product Ops (Jae): For comms cadence — suggest: initial PM emailed within 24h, status update at 7d, closure report at 30d. Use the timerboard to drive those beats.

Sara P.: rotation: propose 4-week IC rotation, with a shadow week for handover. Calendar invite template:

```
Subject: IC oncall — Week of YYYY-MM-DD
Agenda: handover notes, outstanding postmortem items, paging history
```

Will - oncall: I'll add calendar invites and set up a Slack workflow that pings owner X days before SLA.

Ana M.: One more: we should surface recurring patterns as a grouped metric on the board. E.g., 'kv-cache' has 3 incidents in last 6 months -> auto-flag as 'recurring'.

Dmitri K.: +1. Also add a 'confidence' field to action items (low/med/high) so we prioritize.

Sara P.: Can we trial this for the next 8 incidents? If it's helpful, we roll it into postmortem template.

Ana M.: Plan: Will to create sheet + workflow by next Monday (1852430000). Trial for next 8 incidents. Owners to ack within 48h. Volunteers for rotation lead this month?

Will - oncall: I'm the rotation lead this month. Will post the sheet link shortly.

Product Ops (Jae): happy to help with comms cadence and template emails.

Ana M.: Thanks all. If anyone wants to be added to sheet, ping @Will. :thumbsup:
